children: BlockBeats reported on September 13 that Loracle sold $8.68 million worth of HYPE spot holdings over the past 24 hours, resulting in an estimated loss of about $566,500. According to BlockBeats On-chain Detection, the address has recorded a cumulative loss of $16.57 million over the past 30 days and total historical losses of $28.64 million.

title: Loracle Sells HYPE Spot Holdings at a Loss Over the Past 24 Hours
